title: AEM adds Leonardo AW139 to MTP138 and MTP136D radio STC
summary: These modern radios are now easier for Leonardo AW139 operators to install.
body_markdown:
AEM’s modern MTP138 VHF FM and MTP136D P25 radios are now easier for Leonardo[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) operators to install.


AEM has expanded its Transport Canada supplemental type certificate (STC) SH25-17 to include both[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) and AB139 aircraft making fleet radio upgrades even simpler for these airframe operators.


“The[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) serves a broad range of critical missions around the world, particularly in offshore transport, utility operations, and search-and-rescue applications in Europe,” saidTony Weller, sales & marketing director at AEM.


“Expanding airframe coverage on this STC helps operators quickly modernize their fleets using the industry’s most easy-to-use and reliable radio technology.”


AEM continues to add to its radio STCs and is currently pursuing EASA and FAA MTP138 and MTP136D radio STC familiarization and validation to support their European and global customer base.


The[MTP138](https://www.aem-corp.com/our_products/mtp138/) is an easy-to-use and reliable advanced VHF FM radio for all analog channels across the 138MHz to 174MHz frequency band.


While the[MTP136D P25 radio](https://www.aem-corp.com/our_products/mtp136d/) is for digital and analog communication on all channels across the 136MHz to 174MHz frequency band. The radios ship with NVIS as standard and are simple replacements for existing legacy radios, making them easily integrated for tactical mission use and fleet upgrades.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by AEM.*
